invariants.rationale: The instantTime is likely used as an identifier for the update, so it should be non-null.
partitionPath should refer to a directory or logical partition, which should not be null.
fileId should uniquely identify a file and typically should not be null.
The map for updated records should be non-null, even if empty, to avoid NullPointerException.
A merge requires a base file; dataFileToBeMerged should not be null.
